taxonomy.note: Accepted species, but non-native in Texas. Cultivated and naturalized records must not be interpreted as project native-range evidence.

evidence: Current Kew/POWO accepts Clematis terniflora but gives its native range as East Asia and explicitly lists Texas as introduced.
Flora of North America likewise treats it as introduced/naturalized in Texas and the eastern United States.
The project's single wild iNaturalist observation therefore cannot be used as native target-zone evidence.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Species is introduced in Texas, so target-zone native threshold cannot be met.
target_zone_range.guardrail: No county inferred from statewide range, ecoregion, cultivation, plant sales, or an unreconciled historical taxonomic concept.

morphology.look_here_first: Look for a cloud of many small white star-like flowers rather than a leatherflower urn: the vine carries branched cymes/panicles of open flowers above mostly entire 3–5-foliolate leaves.
diagnostic_traits: opposite pinnately 3- or 5-foliolate leaves with mostly entire leaflet margins
many-flowered axillary cymes or compound/paniculate clusters
small white flowers with four thin widely spreading sepals
flowers bisexual, often with some staminate flowers in the same inflorescence
only about 5–10 pistils per flower; broad flattened conspicuously rimmed achenes

confusers.separator: Both may appear as white-flowered vines, but terniflora forms dense masses of many small bisexual flowers with mostly entire leaflets; drummondii is dioecious, has more deeply divided leaflets, and later forms dramatic long-plumed fruit masses.
The native leatherflowers have solitary/few nodding thick-sepaled urns, not masses of small open white flowers.

photo_verification.joey_media_note: No exact Clematis Joey media package was present in the canonical repo at B006 review time; Joey index lists Clematis drummondii/texensis recovery as upcoming work.

installation_guardrail: Do not install as a project target-zone native unless later evidence changes the decision or Calvin explicitly approves an exception.
